clauses.title: Scope – Requirements for
clauses.text: 1. Scope - Requirements for thermoplastic seats and covers for water-closets.

clauses.title: Grades – 1 and
clauses.text: 2. Grades - 1 and 2 based on deflection characteristics

clauses.title: Materials
clauses.text: 3. Materials

clauses.title: Seats and Covers
clauses.text: 3.1 Seats and Covers a) Polystyrene  or b) Polypropylene conforming to requirments specified

clauses.title: Hinging Device
clauses.text: 3.2 Hinging Device —  Bronze or brass or mild steel with nickel chromium plating or aluminium alloy with anodic coating or suitable plastic (with reinforcement), conforming to the prescribed standards.

clauses.title: Manufacture
clauses.text: 4. Manufacture

clauses.title: Seat
clauses.text: 4.1 Seat — The underside of the seats may be either flat or recessed.  Where the underside is flat, the seat shall be a solid moulding, and where the underside is recessed, the section shall be not less than 3 mm at any point.  The seats may be of the closed or open front pattern (see Fig. 1).

clauses.title: The cover shall completely
clauses.text: 4.2 The cover shall completely cover the aperture of the seat and shall be so designed that it is capable of being raised easily from the seat.  The cover shall be not less than 3 mm in thickness at any point.

clauses.title: Finish – The surfaces
clauses.text: 4.4 Finish - The surfaces of the seats, covers and components shall be smooth, free from blisters and delamination and reasonably free from flowlines, contamination, streaking and unintended colour variation colour variation.

clauses.title: Hinging Device – The
clauses.text: 4.6 Hinging Device - The bolts shall have a minimum shank length of 65 mm and a coarse thread of M8 size within 25 mm of the flange of fixing to the pan.

clauses.title: Buffers and Distance Pieces
clauses.text: 4.7 Buffers and Distance Pieces - Each seat (if not provided with distance pipes) shall be provided with not less than three rubber or plastic buffers of size 25 mm × 40 mm × 10 mm for closed front seats and not less than 4 for open front seats, which shall be securely fixed to underside of the seat.

clauses.title: Test
clauses.text: 5. Test

clauses.title: Strength – The seats
clauses.text: 5.1 Strength - The seats shall withstand, without permanent distortion of the seat or the hinge fit tings or damage to any finish, a load of 1 150 N applied for a period of 30 minutes.

clauses.title: Water Absorption – The
clauses.text: 5.2 Water Absorption - The  increase in mass shall be 0.75 percent, Max and on visual in spection after immersion, it shall shown no impairment.

clauses.title: Impact
clauses.text: 5.3 Impact  Resistance

clauses.title: Seats – When tested
clauses.text: 5.3.1  Seats - When tested for impact, the seat, hinges and buffers/distance pieces shall show no  visible damage.

clauses.title: Covers – When tested
clauses.text: 5.3.2  Covers - When tested for impact, the cover, cover hinges and cover buffers shall show no visible damage.

clauses.title: Rigidity
clauses.text: 5.4 Rigidity

clauses.title: Seats
clauses.text: 5.4.1 Seats — The maximum deflection shall be as given below and on visual inspection after the load is removed, the seats shall not show any fracture (See Annex F of the standard) Grade Deflection, mm 1 12.5 2 20.0

clauses.title: Covers – The maximum
clauses.text: 5.4.2  Covers -  The maximum deflection shall be as given below and on visual inspection after the load is removed, the cover shall not show any fracture and no part of the edge of the cover shall be pushed through the seat opening Grade Deflection, mm 1 25 2 40

clauses.title: Staining by Seats and Covers
clauses.text: 5.5 Staining by Seats and Covers — There shall not be any visible colour transfer to the white cloth.

clauses.title: Staining and/or Other Surface
clauses.text: 5.6 Staining and/or Other Surface  Deterioration of Seats and Covers — There shall not be any change of colour or other adverse change in surface characteristics.

clauses.title: Surface Hardness
clauses.text: 5.7 Surface Hardness - Minimum value of Rockwell Hardness Number (HR) shall be `L45'.

clauses.title: Endurance Test
clauses.text: 5.8 Endurance Test  for Seats, Covers   and  Buffers— Neither seat, cover or buffer should be damaged or dislocated.  This is a type test. Note — For method of test, refer to Appendixs B to M of the standard. For  detailed information, refer to IS 2548 (Part 1) : 1996 Specification for plastic seats and covers for water closets: Part 1  Thermoplastic seats and covers (fifth revision).
